page.overview:
What is Chocolate Animatronics?

The chocolate animatronics are a set of animatronic skins for Five Nights at Freddy's AR: Special Delivery. Chocolate Bonnie was the first chocolate animatronic skin released.

Two chocolate animatronic skins, Chocolate Freddy and Chocolate Chica, were released as merchandise by Funko. Whether both skins were planned to get implemented into Special Delivery's is unknown.

Based on the classic animatronics, their suits are completely made out of different chocolate flavors and other sweets, with some parts bitten off to reveal candy-textured endoskeletons.

Chocolate Bonnie is a chocolate variant of Bonnie and added on April 10, 2020 as the Easter event's first skin. He is Bonnie's first featured animatronic skin. One of the most recurring animatronic skins, Chocolate Bonnie returned on June 23, 2020 for a little bit to celebrate his own exclusive merchandise line. He later reappeared once again on September 24, 2020 for a mini event.
